before.sql: SELECT id,headword,language,readings_json,pos,forms_json FROM entries WHERE language=? AND (headword=? OR headword_nfc=?) LIMIT 30

after.sql: SELECT rowid AS lookup_order,id,headword,language,readings_json,pos,forms_json FROM entries WHERE language=? AND headword=? ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 30

plan.detail: SEARCH entries USING INDEX entries_headword (language=? AND headword=?)

after.sql: SELECT rowid AS lookup_order,id,headword,language,readings_json,pos,forms_json FROM entries WHERE language=? AND headword_nfc=? ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 30

plan.detail: SEARCH entries USING INDEX entries_nfc (language=? AND headword_nfc=?)

unchangedForms.sql: SELECT e.id,e.headword,e.language,e.readings_json,e.pos,e.forms_json,f.form FROM forms f JOIN entries e ON e.id=f.entry_id WHERE e.language=? AND (f.form=? OR f.form_nfc=?) LIMIT 60

interpretation: Before: only language prefix is constrained. After: exact and NFC queries constrain both indexed values. Forms already used its two value indexes and entry primary key and was left unchanged.
